import hashlib, json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
logs=root/"logs/v0.1.1"
baseline=json.loads((logs/"input_hashes.json").read_text())
for name, expected in baseline.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected, "受保护文件变化: "+name
print("PASS:",len(baseline),"个受保护文件字节未变（固定配置、旧求导模块、合同/路线图、旧日志、其他工程和全局设置）。")
assert (root/"PROGRESS.md").read_text().endswith((logs/"before_PROGRESS.md").read_text())
print("PASS: v0.0.3 进度原文完整保留。")
formal=sorted(list(root.glob("*.lean"))+list((root/"LeanPML").rglob("*.lean")))
assert len(formal)==5
decls=[]
for f in formal:
 code=re.sub(r"/-[\s\S]*?-/", "", f.read_text())
 code=re.sub(r"--[^\n]*","",code)
 assert not re.search(r"\b(sorry|admit|axiom|sorryAx)\b",code), str(f)
 ns=re.search(r"^namespace (\S+)",code,re.M)
 if ns: decls.extend(ns.group(1)+"."+name for name in re.findall(r"^theorem (\S+)",code,re.M))
 output=root/".lake/build/lib/lean"/f.relative_to(root).with_suffix(".olean")
 assert output.is_file(),str(output)
audited=re.findall(r"^#print axioms (LeanPML\.\S+)",(root/"Audit.lean").read_text(),re.M)
assert len(decls)==12 and len(audited)==12 and set(decls)==set(audited)
assert not (root/"LeanPML/Debye").exists()
print("PASS: 五个正式模块均有构建产物；12条项目定理全部列入 Audit；无证明占位；无 v0.1.2 模块。")
latest_build="20261006T160348_400758_lake_build_retry2"
audit="20261006T160544_665228_axioms_audit"
for stem in [latest_build,audit]:
 m=json.loads((logs/(stem+".json")).read_text())
 assert m["exit_code"]==0 and m["status"]=="finished" and m["cwd"]==str(root)
 body=(logs/(stem+".log")).read_text()
 pairs=re.findall(r"'([^']+)' depends on axioms: \[([^\]]+)\]",body)
 assert len(pairs)==12 and {name for name,_ in pairs}==set(decls)
 for name,axioms in pairs:
  assert set(axioms.split(", "))=={"propext","Classical.choice","Quot.sound"},name
 assert "sorryAx" not in body
print("PASS: 最终默认构建与独立审计实际退出0；全部定理仅依赖三项标准基础公理。")
for stem in ["20261006T160248_266606_lake_build","20261006T160319_324239_lake_build_retry"]:
 m=json.loads((logs/(stem+".json")).read_text())
 assert m["exit_code"]==1
 assert (logs/(stem+".log")).is_file()
print("PASS: 两次修复前构建失败及完整输出保留。")
assert 'defaultTargets = ["LeanPML", "Audit"]' in (root/"lakefile.toml").read_text()
for name in ["LeanPML.Tutorial.LocalEnergy","LeanPML.Time.Monotonicity","LeanPML.Tutorial.ScalarEnergy"]:
 assert "import "+name in (root/"LeanPML.lean").read_text()
manifest=json.loads((root/"lake-manifest.json").read_text())
for package in manifest["packages"]:
 repo=root/".lake/packages"/package["name"]
 head=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(repo),"rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()
 assert package["rev"]==head,package["name"]
print("PASS: 默认导入链覆盖所有证明模块，",len(manifest["packages"]),"个依赖实际HEAD与固定manifest一致。")
for name in ["README.md","PROGRESS.md"]:
 body=(root/name).read_text()
 for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",body):
  target=target.strip("<>")
  if target.startswith(("http:", "https:", "#")): continue
  target=re.sub(r":\d+$","",target.split("#",1)[0])
  path=Path(target) if target.startswith("/") else root/target
  assert path.exists(),name+": "+target
 assert len(re.findall(r"^\$\$$",body,re.M))%2==0,name
 assert len(re.findall(r"^\x60\x60\x60",body,re.M))%2==0,name
print("PASS: 当前README/PROGRESS本地链接有效，显示数学及代码块成对。")
artifacts=formal+[root/n for n in ["lean-toolchain","lakefile.toml","lake-manifest.json","scripts/run_logged.py","README.md"]]
hashes={str(f.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in artifacts}
(logs/"verified_artifact_hashes.json").write_text(json.dumps(hashes,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print("已保存正式源码、固定配置、日志脚本及README的交付哈希（PROGRESS另含本次日志链接，未冻结其字节）。")
print("FINAL: v0.1.1 验收通过；下一阶段仅登记入口，未实现。")
